methodology.name: sorted-rank positional lab
methodology.positionMeaning: rank after ascending sort in the official winning combination, NOT physical order of draw
methodology.sourceNote: Official archive presents the 10-number winning combination sorted ascending; stored archive parser sorts it too. This lab cannot infer physical extraction order.

walkForward.score: exact intersection hits among the 10-number set; theoretical expectation 5

methodology.positionPrior: Exact order-statistic distribution for a uniformly random 10-of-20 set; empirical rank frequencies shrink toward this prior (alpha=100).
methodology.numerone: Kept separate; not used in positional model.
